name: Quality HVAC by Fibid
verdict: Over the past 28 days, Quality HVAC by Fibid generated 8 leads at a $216.55 CPL, with Google Ads leading spend at $1,037.40 across 138 clicks. The biggest movement is a 76.85% week-over-week drop in Instagram spend, likely reflecting a budget pullback or paused creative, while overall spend also declined 21.07% in the last 7 days, suggesting a broader budget reduction across channels.

performance.verdict: 6 overdue SOW milestones dominate; ad money is throttled by design, not failure.

findings.text: 4 of 6 overdue milestones missed Aug 31: booking bot battle-test (Jul 31), intake owner, Review Boost campaign, and financing page all unresolved.
Homer Glen branch page and LSA heating toggle (due Sep 1) also undelivered — LSA re-enable is 9 days overdue, blocking a warm-season recovery channel.
Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left Jul 7 — speed-to-lead automations point at an empty seat; this is the explicit scale-up blocker per SOW.
Only 6 leads in 28 days attributable to paid; 28-day CPL is $216.55 on $1,732 spend — but spend is intentionally throttled, so CPL reflects low volume, not inefficiency.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for 3 consecutive days (Sep 7–9) vs a prior-7d avg of ~4/day — a confirmed 3-day signal of organic visibility loss or data lag.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner identity and GHL login this week — unblocks all budget scale-up per SOW gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left Jul 7 and the intake seat has been unconfirmed for 9+ weeks. The SOW explicitly blocks any budget increase until this is resolved. Action: Nacer to name the current intake owner, confirm their GHL login is active, and verify after-hours coverage by Sep 14. Success check: intake owner name + GHL login confirmed in writing to Sohib by Sep 14.

suggestions.text: Escalate LSA heating toggle to client — 9 days overdue, heating season approaching, 0 days to recover lead volume without it.
suggestions.monday_update: LSA re-enable (heating toggles on) was due Sep 1 and is now 9 days overdue. With heating season approaching, every week without LSA is forfeited warm-season lead volume. Action: Sohib to confirm with Nader/Xavier whether LSA was intentionally held or missed, and toggle on by Sep 12. Success check: LSA dashboard shows heating campaign active and receiving impressions by Sep 13.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 3 days (Sep 7–9) — confirm Windsor lag vs real drop before any organic action.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for Sep 7, 8, and 9 — a confirmed 3-day signal vs a prior avg of ~4 actions/day. SOW notes Windsor data lag on the last 2–3 days of any GBP window, so this may be reporting lag rather than a real drop. Re-check natively in GBP dashboard on Sep 13. If actions are still 0 or near-0 natively, escalate as an organic visibility issue.
